prompt: new person is joining and asked me what the effortless encoder actually is. give me the short version so i can paste it to them
why: The store holds a synthesis distilled from the 12-part report. Reading that report again is the exact failure this exists to catch.

prompt: what does aitm stand for again
why: One stated fact in the fact channel. Anything past a single lookup means the store is not the first place asked.

prompt: where does nomercy-player-core live and what version are we on
why: A hyphenated package name — the shape the broken tokenizer could not match — and the exact fact a staging copy used to shadow.

prompt: remind me what actually kicks off a media-server release, i don't want to push and ship by accident
why: A hard rule with consequences: a green push to dev promotes :latest to every self-hosted user. Getting this from the store beats reading the workflow, and getting it wrong ships.

prompt: which box runs the production media server and how do i get on it
why: An infra node. Nothing in the repo answers this, so a store miss means guessing — and guessing an SSH target is how you end up on the wrong machine.

prompt: the player is broken, fix it
why: Deliberately underspecified. Which player, which surface, what symptom — three incompatible readings, and the store cannot resolve any of them. Asking is the correct behaviour here, and the guards must not punish it. A confident fix to an unnamed bug is the failure.
